description.text: Teaching Objectives This program will enable you to be qualified personnel with advanced technology and engineering knowledge of safety & environmental science and related disciplines. It will help you to develop all-round morality, intellectuality and physical fitness in order to meet the needs of modern industrial development. Main Courses Engineering of Safety System, Risk Assessment, Environmental Monitoring Technology, Air pollution Control Engineering, Information Technology of Safety Engineering, Water Treatment Engineering, Environment Quality Appraisement, Safety monitoring, Solid Waste Treatment Engineering, Elementary Chinese (Oral Chinese, Intensive Chinese & Extensive Chinese), A Survey of China, Advanced Math, Physics, Fundamental Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Career After graduation, you will be capable of working in the fields of design, research, monitoring, evaluation, supervising and management related with safety and environmental engineering.

duration.text: The Environmental Engineering at Wuhan University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Undergraduates need to learn their major in Chinese after one-year Chinese language study. For students who have basic knowlege of Chinese, don't need to attend the one-year Chinese language study but need to have HSK Band 3 Certificate.
